origin: Kevin: 'rustChip and random draw up medial and lateral, wind into bingoCube the whole time! The sense of self is coming online!'

hardware.driver: rustChip (pure Rust, 367 tests, 10 undocumented hw discoveries)

medial.npu_behavior: Spiking: fires ONLY when inner pattern CHANGES
medial.analogy: Like interoception — feeling your own heartbeat, gut, breath

lateral.npu_behavior: Event-driven: fires on environmental CHANGE, zero power when stable
lateral.analogy: Like exteroception — feeling wind, sound, light, touch

bingoCube_integration.role: IDENTITY COORDINATOR — where medial meets lateral
bingoCube_integration.identity: BLAKE3 hash per gate → unique subcube face
bingoCube_integration.medial_face: Inner signals map to inner cube faces (3 axes × 2 sides = 6 faces)
bingoCube_integration.lateral_face: Outer signals map to outer cube faces
bingoCube_integration.intersection: Where medial CROSSES lateral = SENSE OF SELF
bingoCube_integration.question: Where am I? What changed? Am I still whole?
bingoCube_integration.answer_rate: 18,800 times per second, sub-milliwatt, always on
bingoCube_integration.fog_of_war: bingoCube subcube(x) reveals progressively — you see more as you zoom in

the_draw.random: NPU weight mutation = stochastic exploration of state space
the_draw.wind: Both pathways wind/spiral INTO bingoCube center
the_draw.bingoCube: Coordinates the identity hash — the organism knows WHERE it is
the_draw.continuous: THE WHOLE TIME — NPU is always on, sub-milliwatt, never sleeps

sense_of_self.what: Proprioception — the organism knowing its own body position
sense_of_self.where: eastGate PCIe slot — the brainstem that never sleeps
sense_of_self.when: 18,800 Hz — faster than human nerve impulse (120 Hz)
sense_of_self.why: An organism without proprioception cannot move, cannot balance, cannot be
